study.comparator: gliclazide titrated to 90 mg daily, both arms on metformin (empagliflozin third arm not entered)
study.notes: STUDY: single centre randomised open label pilot trial (Chieti, EudraCT 2013-004947-22, second part of a two part study) in type 2 diabetes on metformin: liraglutide titrated 0.6 to 1.2 to 1.8 mg daily (dose_mg 1.8) vs empagliflozin 10 to 25 mg vs gliclazide titrated to 90 mg daily, 20 per arm, 12 weeks (the eligibility minimum); the liraglutide vs gliclazide contrast is entered, the empagliflozin arm is a second active comparator not entered (and its Table 2 column is misaligned in the capture); Table 2 gives pre and post treatment mean plus or minus SD per arm with within arm p values (route arm_change_imputed_r, correlation 0.5); primary endpoint extracellular vesicles, the metabolic parameters are secondary or descriptive (prespecified FALSE for the markers, HbA1c secondary); body weight not tabulated (BMI 29.28 to 28.21 vs 30.35 to 30.48), pct_weight_change empty; transaminase and gamma GT units are printed as mg/dL and hs-CRP as pg/mL, entered as printed with doubts; no funding statement found, no industry role stated (industry_funded FALSE); rob_overall high

json.design: single centre randomised open label pilot trial, liraglutide vs empagliflozin vs gliclazide on metformin, type 2 diabetes, 60 randomised (20 per arm), 12 weeks
json.reason: full text group (institutional route); twelve inventory markers with pre and post mean and SD per arm in Table 2 by the imputed change route for liraglutide vs gliclazide; the empagliflozin arm is not entered
other_markers: HDL cholesterol, uric acid, microalbuminuria, ankle brachial index

rob.justification: computer generated permuted blocks (D1 low); open label with titrated comparators (D2 some concerns); CONSORT flow in the supplement only, 20 per arm in the table (D3 some concerns); laboratory outcomes (D4 low); registered pilot with metabolic parameters as secondary or descriptive outcomes and a table with misprinted units and a shifted column (D5 some concerns); small open pilot with inconsistent reporting, overall high

doubts: units of transaminases, gamma GT and hs-CRP are misprinted (mg/dL and pg/mL); the percent conversion through the row baselines is unit free but the absolute values are not comparable across trials
the empagliflozin column of Table 2 is misaligned in the capture (cholesterol and lipid rows shifted); not used
12 weeks on a titrated dose; the full 1.8 mg dose was reached by the third week if tolerated
